title: Administration
adminOnly: This page is for system administrators.

placeholder.keyStored: A key is saved — type to change it

companies.title: Companies
companies.help: The short code (2–8 letters/digits) is used in work item numbers ({Gönderen}, {Alıcı}) and as the company code in the new project wizard. If it is empty, the code in the number is derived from the company name. The address and e-mail are suggested as recipient details in formal letters.

googleDomain.title: Allowed Domain
googleDomain.description: When this is on, a person signing in with Google whose domain is in the list and who has no CDE account yet gets a normal user account. They do not become an administrator. A disabled account still cannot sign in.

newUser.title: New User
newUser.capacityWarning: With this addition: {{finding}}. {{action}} Details: System Status → Capacity.

fields.initialPassword: Initial Password (at least 10 characters — the user changes it under My Account)

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.noTest: No capacity test has been run yet.

test.title: Run Live Test
test.description: The server measures itself; the result shows how many people it can carry and what is missing. Project files are not touched.
test.demoNotice: Sample data: the test engine is still a sample. No load is put on the server; the charts replay a sample run.
test.quickText: Hardware, processor, disk and database speed, a sample IFC conversion, memory headroom.
test.loadText: Virtual users increase step by step; the test stops when the p95 response time exceeds {{p95}} ms, errors exceed {{errorRate}} or the processor exceeds {{cpu}}.
test.loadWarning: Users working during the test may notice slowness. If real user traffic starts, the test stops itself.

run.noLimit: No limit was exceeded up to the top step.
run.firstStepOver: Even the first step was over the limit: {{reason}}.

guide.title: Capacity Guide
guide.intro: Which server is needed for how many users.
guide.estimated: The figures are estimates; they will be updated with a reference measurement.
guide.concurrency: At peak time, {{percent}} of registered users are assumed to work at the same time.
guide.serverSummaryDisk: This server: {{cpu}} vCPU · {{ram}} GB RAM · {{total}} data disk ({{free}} free) · {{os}}.

disk.title: How Disk Is Calculated
disk.description: Disk grows with model volume, not with users: uploaded files × 1.6 (Fragments and previews) + database + 30% free space. Backups are kept on a separate target.

operations.title: How to Run It
operations.whenToTest: Run the capacity test at first installation, when the hardware changes and after a major version upgrade.
operations.oldTest: A test older than {{days}} days shows yellow.
operations.plan: Plan hardware when the number of users reaches 90% of the tier limit; once the limit is exceeded the warning turns red.
operations.afterHours: Run the full load test outside working hours; the Quick Check is always safe.
operations.disk: Extend the disk before it passes 80%.
operations.office: Large IFC conversions and the office server need extra memory; a separate machine is recommended for the office server.

meaning.title: What the Warnings Mean
meaning.ok: The server can handle this number of users.
meaning.warn: The limit is close, the test is old or the disk is filling up. Plan ahead.
meaning.danger: The server cannot handle the number of users. Apply the action shown on screen (RAM, processor, disk).

runs.title: Capacity Reports
runs.empty: No tests yet. Start with Run Live Test.
runs.footnote: Tests are deleted when the server restarts; a permanent report history will come in a later step.

systemStatus.title: System Status
systemStatus.checked: Last check {{time}}. Automatic backup is running; no Grafana or SSH needed.

resources.title: Resources
resources.last24: Last 24 hours. The machine, not project content.

queue.title: Job Queue
queue.description: Conversion, preview and the nightly backup run in this queue.
queue.spark: Waiting, last 24 hours — the queue is draining
queue.dialogDescription: Conversion, preview, clash and backup. A failed job can be queued again.

logs.noDwg: No DWG converter; {{file}} is waiting in the queue

backup.title: Automatic Backup
backup.notScheduled: Scheduling is not on yet. Once the target and the night-time hour are set, the backup job enters the queue.
backup.queued: Backup queued; it finishes in a few minutes.
backup.copiesDescription: Each copy holds the database, the files and the Recovery Package. The latest copy cannot be deleted. Only a system administrator deletes an old copy.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete the backup of {{date}}? This cannot be undone.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.cleaned: Derivatives deleted; the files remain. Previews and Fragments are regenerated when first opened.
maintenance.description: Previews and Fragments can be regenerated. Project files and the database are not deleted from here.
maintenance.confirm: Previews and Fragments will be deleted (about {{size}}). Uploaded files and the database stay.

recentErrors.title: Recent Errors
recentErrors.description: Secrets are masked. Not the raw server log; queue and backup lines.
recentErrors.dialogDescription: Keys, sessions and access tokens do not appear in the lines. Project files are not opened.

kill.title: Turn Off All External Connections
kill.confirmOff: The server's connections to every address outside the network will be cut: cloud AI, external e-mail and office servers. AI switches to fully local mode and the external client queue stops.
kill.confirmOn: External connections will be reopened; each connection returns to its own setting.
kill.on: On. The server connects only to addresses on the local network; AI runs fully locally and the external client queue has stopped.
kill.onSince: On ({{date}}). The server connects only to addresses on the local network; AI runs fully locally and the external client queue has stopped.
kill.onSinceBy: On ({{date}}, {{name}}). The server connects only to addresses on the local network; AI runs fully locally and the external client queue has stopped.
kill.off: Off. When turned on, the server connects to no address outside the network; the local network and the internal network list keep working.

summary.selectedMode: Selected mode: {{mode}}; running fully locally because external connections are off.
summary.permissionsInvalid: The permissions do not apply right now: the system mode does not allow external providers.

settings.title: Settings

options.redactLocal: Mask for the Local Model Too

settings.redactLocalHint: (personal data goes to the local model with placeholders too)
settings.redactNamesHint: (role and company are sent instead of the name, e.g. "Project Manager (Poyraz)")
settings.always: In every prompt to AI outside the network, e-mail addresses, phone numbers, Turkish ID numbers and IBANs are always replaced with placeholders. The originals are put back when the answer is shown to you; the mapping is kept in memory only for that call.
settings.lanHelp: Servers that are on your network even though their names look public (one name per line, "*.domain" or an IPv4 range). Private IP ranges and single-label names are already local. The entries in this list count as local: they keep working while all external connections are off, and AI prompts to them are not masked.

location.localHint: Inside your network (private IP range or internal network list)
location.inboundHint: External clients connect to the CDE; the server does not connect out

connections.stoppedHint: Does not work while external connections are off.

log.description: The time, purpose, server, size and result of every external call are kept; the content never is. Entries are deleted every day once the retention period has passed.
log.empty: No entries. The server made no external connection matching this filter.

mode.title: AI Mode
mode.killSwitch: All external connections are off (Privacy Centre): AI runs fully locally and the external client queue has stopped. The mode you choose applies once connections are reopened.
mode.projectsLimit: Projects cannot go beyond this limit: the project administrator can turn AI off under Project Settings → AI, or choose only providers the system mode allows. External models work only in projects that allow them.
mode.order: Order: local model → cloud model → "Run with My Own AI" (fallback). The options can be combined.

options.allowWrite: Allow Read + Write Access Tokens (needed for the task queue and the saving tools)

editorTexts.none: Office files open only in the browser viewers; to edit, they are downloaded and uploaded again.
editorTexts.onlyoffice: AGPL-3.0. The editor most faithful to Microsoft formats (docx/xlsx/pptx). The free edition allows at most 20 concurrent connections. Needs WOPI_ENABLED=true and JWT.
editorTexts.collabora: MPL-2.0, based on LibreOffice. Strong with ODF and older formats (doc/xls/ppt). The CODE edition has no connection limit but shows a warning as load grows.

converterTexts.auto: The editor's server if an editor is set up; otherwise LibreOffice on this server if present; otherwise no PDF is made (files still open in the browser).
converterTexts.onlyoffice: ConvertService API (JWT). ONLYOFFICE downloads the file from the CDE through a single-use address.
converterTexts.collabora: /cool/convert-to/pdf. Collabora must allow the CDE server (net.post_allow).
converterTexts.gotenberg: MIT-licensed lightweight conversion service with LibreOffice (/forms/libreoffice/convert). It only converts; it does not edit.
converterTexts.local: soffice installed on this server. A last resort; no longer in the Docker image.
converterTexts.none: Conversion is off. Office files get no PDF view, markup or visual comparison.

overview.title: Status
overview.testHint: Tries the editor and the converter with the saved settings
overview.fromEnv: Defaults from environment variables: {{vars}}. A value saved here takes precedence.

wopi.title: Browser Editing (WOPI)

fields.editorUrl: Editor Address (as reached by the CDE server)
fields.publicUrl: Address Used by the Browser (if different)
fields.wopiBase: The CDE Address as Seen by the Editor

placeholder.publicUrl: e.g. https://office.company.com — if empty, the address the editor reports

options.verifyProof: Verify the Signature of WOPI Requests (X-WOPI-Proof, with the editor's discovery key). Do not turn this off except while troubleshooting.

wopi.help: The editor reads the file from here and saves it here (e.g. http://app:8080 on a Docker network). ONLYOFFICE conversion uses this address too.

converter.title: Office → PDF Converter
converter.description: For the PDF view of office files, markup, visual revision comparison and batch PDF. Files are sent only to the address set here.

connection.title: Connection Details
connection.description: OpenCDE clients (Solibri, IfcOpenShell, BCF tools) first ask for the server address; they find the other addresses themselves through /foundation/versions and /foundation/1.1/auth. Some forms ask for each one separately.
connection.notConfigured: These addresses were derived from the address of the request. On the server, set the CDE_PUBLIC_URL variable to the HTTPS address the customer uses (e.g. https://cde.company.local).

oauth.secretNotice: Copy the secret for "{{name}}" now; it will not be shown again:

apps.title: OAuth Applications
apps.aecPilotHint: Ready-made entry for the Revit / Civil 3D add-in: public client, local redirect, OpenCDE Documents permission
apps.description: Applications connect with the user's consent and with the user's own project and folder permissions. The user can remove access under My Account → Connected Applications.
apps.rotateConfirm: Generate a new secret for "{{name}}"? The old secret stops working immediately.
apps.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? All users' consents and access tokens are deleted too.

info.title: {{name}}: Connection Details
info.description: The Solibri private connection form and other OpenCDE clients ask for these values.
info.secretHint: The secret is shown only when it is created; if it is lost, regenerate it.

dialog.redirectHelp: Addresses must match exactly. For desktop applications, http://127.0.0.1 and http://localhost match any port. Other addresses must use https.
dialog.scopesHelp: Read and Write open the existing SiteKeep API. The BCF and Documents permissions are for the OpenCDE APIs.

forma.title: Forma Sync
forma.description: Autodesk ACC / Forma folders and files. Records (issues, reviews) sync separately; the file engine does not exist yet — this screen is a sample.

syncNow.title: Sync Now
syncNow.confirm: The file sync will look as if it was queued. The engine does not exist yet; no files come down from ACC.

connection.hint: Connect an ACC project under Project Settings → Autodesk.

recent.title: Recently Transferred
recent.description: Names that do not match are skipped; files deleted at the source stay in the CDE. Once the engine is connected this list becomes `integration_sync_runs`.

addDialog.title: Add Mapping
addDialog.hint: Not saved. Once Data Management is connected, it is chosen from the folder tree.

license.title: Licence

statusText.none: SiteKeep Community: the core is free and not limited. Install a licence to turn on Enterprise modules.
statusText.not_yet: The licence starts on its validity date; until then Enterprise modules stay off.
statusText.expiring: The licence ends in {{days}} days. Renew it to keep the Enterprise modules.
statusText.grace: The licence has ended. Enterprise modules become read-only on {{date}} unless it is renewed.
statusText.read_only: The licence has ended: Enterprise modules are read-only until it is renewed. The core is not affected.
statusText.invalid: The licence file cannot be used.

license.notEnforced: Licence checks are off on this installation (SITEKEEP_LICENSE_ENFORCE): modules follow the installed packages.
license.clockBehind: The server clock is behind the latest time seen; the licence is judged by that time.
license.installationText: Send this id when you ask for a licence; the licence is made for this installation.
license.uploadText: Choose the licence file (license.json) you received.
license.removeText: Enterprise modules turn off; their data stays and comes back with a licence.

problems.format: This is not a SiteKeep licence file.
problems.unknown_key: The licence was signed with a key this version does not know.
problems.dev_key_in_production: This is a development licence; it does not work on a production installation.
problems.signature: The licence signature does not match: the file was changed or damaged.
problems.payload: The licence content cannot be read.
problems.other_installation: This licence belongs to another installation.
problems.build_after_support: This SiteKeep version was released after the support period ended.

license.seatsOver: {{count}} more active users than the licence allows: Enterprise modules are read-only until accounts are disabled or seats are added.
